strengths_deep_dive: Zakat Foundation of America demonstrates high financial efficiency in its humanitarian operations. In FY2024, the charity directed <cite id="1">93.3% of its expenses directly to program services</cite>, outperforming the humanitarian peer median of 89.2% and the 75% sector benchmark. Growth has been rapid, with total revenue rising to <cite id="3">$34,923,926 in FY2024</cite>, achieving a <cite id="3">3-year CAGR of 40.2%</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Zakat Foundation of America operates as an established global relief provider focused on emergency aid and sustainable community development. Founded in 2001, the organization delivers direct assistance across international crisis zones including Gaza, Yemen, and Sudan. Financial filings show total revenue reached <cite id="3">$34,923,926 in FY2024</cite>, supported by a strong multi-year growth trajectory with a <cite id="3">3-year revenue CAGR of 40.2%</cite>. Program spending remains efficient, with a <cite id="1">93.3% program expense ratio</cite> that exceeds the peer median of 89.2% and beats the 75% industry standard. The foundation maintains strong financial reserves with <cite id="1">17.6 months of working capital</cite>. In 2024, the foundation delivered over <cite id="4">11.9 million Ramadan meals</cite> and supported <cite id="5">11,200 patients in Gaza</cite>. While operational efficiency is high, the charity lacks a formal, published theory of change and maintains a high reserve level relative to typical operating needs.
